summary: Allow explicit daemon placement of unlaned seats without overriding declared lanes

rules.detail: No replicated rules or digest changes.

compatibility.detail: Optional [unlaned_seat] daemon configuration requires slice; memoryMax and memorySwapMax integer byte counts and oomPolicy are independently optional. Missing properties emit no corresponding systemd property argument. Absent table preserves existing launches. Older daemons reject the new table; remove it before downgrade. No wire changes.

downtime.detail: Only newly launched daemon seats without a lane receive placement. Existing seats are unchanged.

manual.detail: Upgrade: install/start the new daemon first, then add [unlaned_seat] and restart. Downgrade: remove the table first, then install the old daemon. Remove generic scope drop-ins that override Slice. OOMPolicy on scopes requires systemd 254 or newer. See docs/st3/seat-lanes.md.

recovery.detail: Remove the optional table and restart the daemon to restore default placement for subsequent starts. No stored graph migration.
